description: This file defines the ProjectSearchFilterParams class which extends FilterParams to specify filtering parameters for project searches within the OrangeHRM Time plugin. It includes properties for project IDs, customer IDs, employee numbers, project or customer names, and exclusions, along with getter and setter methods for each.

classes.name: ProjectSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A data transfer object for specifying search filters for projects, including IDs, names, and exclusion criteria.

methods.name: getProjectIds
methods.description: Returns the array of project IDs to filter by, or null if none set.

methods.name: setProjectIds
methods.description: Sets the array of project IDs to filter by.

methods.name: getCustomerId
methods.description: Returns the customer ID filter, or null if not set.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number filter, or null if not set.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the project or customer name filter, or null if not set.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the project or customer name filter.

methods.name: getCustomerOrProjectName
methods.description: Returns the customer or project name filter, or null if not set.

methods.name: setCustomerOrProjectName
methods.description: Sets the customer or project name filter.

methods.name: getExcludeProjectIds
methods.description: Returns the array of project IDs to exclude, or null if none set.

methods.name: setExcludeProjectIds
methods.description: Sets the array of project IDs to exclude.
